afternoon.definition: The part of the day between noon and evening.
afternoon.example: We have soccer practice this afternoon.

angry.example: He was angry because someone broke his toy.

bathroom.definition: A room with a toilet and usually a sink or bath.
bathroom.example: May I use the bathroom, please?

bedroom.definition: A room used mainly for sleeping.

bench.definition: A long seat for two or more people.
bench.example: We sat on a bench in the park.

blanket.definition: A large piece of soft material used for warmth, especially on a bed.
blanket.example: She pulled the blanket over her shoulders.

bottle.definition: A container with a narrow neck used for holding liquids.
bottle.example: He filled his bottle with water.

bread.definition: Food made from flour and baked into a loaf or other shape.
bread.example: I made a sandwich with fresh bread.

break.definition: To damage something so that it separates or stops working.
break.example: Be careful not to break the glass.

button.definition: A small fastener used to close clothing, or a control that you press.
button.example: Press the green button to start the machine.

cheese.definition: A food made from milk that can be soft or firm.
cheese.example: She added cheese to her sandwich.

crayon.definition: A colored stick of wax used for drawing.
crayon.example: He colored the sun with a yellow crayon.

eight.definition: The number that comes after seven and before nine.
eight.example: There are eight pencils in the box.

eleven.definition: The number that comes after ten and before twelve.

great.example: We had a great time at the museum.

house.example: Their house has a red roof.

jacket.definition: A short coat worn on the upper body.
jacket.example: Take a jacket because it may get cold.

knee.definition: The joint in the middle of the leg.
knee.example: She hurt her knee when she fell.

light.definition: Something that makes it possible to see, or illumination from a source.

lunch.definition: The meal usually eaten around the middle of the day.

monkey.definition: An animal with a long or short tail that can climb well and is related to apes.
monkey.example: The monkey climbed quickly up the tree.

mouse.definition: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long tail.
mouse.example: A mouse ran behind the cupboard.

orange.definition: A round citrus fruit with orange skin and juicy sections.
orange.example: He peeled an orange for a snack.

pizza.definition: A baked flat bread topped with sauce, cheese, and other ingredients.
pizza.example: We ordered a vegetable pizza for dinner.

pocket.definition: A small sewn pouch in clothing used to carry things.
pocket.example: My keys are in my pocket.

purple.definition: A color made by combining red and blue.

queen.definition: A female ruler of a kingdom, or the wife of a king.

schoolbag.definition: A bag used to carry books and school supplies.
schoolbag.example: Put your homework in your schoolbag.

spring.definition: The season between winter and summer.

street.definition: A public road in a town or city, usually with buildings along it.
street.example: Their school is across the street.

strong.definition: Having a lot of physical power or able to resist force.
strong.example: The strong wind shook the trees.

three.definition: The number that comes after two and before four.

tomato.definition: A soft red or yellow fruit often eaten as a vegetable.
tomato.example: She sliced a tomato for the salad.

tooth.definition: One of the hard white structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing.
tooth.example: I lost a baby tooth yesterday.

turtle.definition: A reptile with a hard shell that protects its body.
turtle.example: The turtle moved slowly across the sand.

watch.definition: A small clock worn on the wrist.
watch.example: His watch says it is almost noon.

wednesday.definition: The day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday.
wednesday.example: Our music class is on Wednesday.

woman.example: The woman at the desk helped us.

write.definition: To make letters, words, or symbols on a surface.
write.example: Please write your answer in complete sentences.

wrong.example: That answer is wrong, so try again.

yellow.definition: The color of lemons and bright sunshine.

young.definition: Having lived for only a short time; not old.
young.example: The young puppy likes to play.
